chapter: Los Angeles with Mutt Carey and the taxi dances
title: Personnel of Mutt Carey's band including Alex Hill
summary: Joe starts naming the seven-piece band, including Alex Hill, who wrote Beau-Koo Jack with Louis, and Pops Foster; tape change.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: That was a four-piece band or something?
Who was in that band? Do you remember?
In that band was Alex Hill...
Was that the same Alex Hill who made the Sepian records and all that stuff?
Oh, yeah. Alec Hill was the guy who wrote that tune with Louis called "Beau-Koo Jack," and he wrote a whole little portfolio of music together. And Pops Foster...
